parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, typically made of lightweight plastic. It covers the writing tip to prevent ink from drying out.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip and prevents ink leakage or drying. It may also have a clip for attaching the pen to pockets or notebooks.
parts.Movement_description: The cap can be removed or snapped onto the pen body, allowing for easy access to the writing tip.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of durable plastic and designed to hold the ink reservoir and writing tip.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support, houses the ink cartridge, and serves as the main gripping area during writing.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during use, though it may be twisted or clicked depending on the pen mechanism.
